parameters.query: =INSERT INTO whatsapp_queue (producto, drive_id) SELECT LEFT('{{ ($json.PRODUCTO || $json.producto || '').replace(/'/g, "''").replace(/Limpiar.*$/,'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim() }}', 255), regexp_replace('{{ $json.DRIVE_ID || $json.drive_id }}', '\s.*$', '') WHERE regexp_replace('{{ $json.DRIVE_ID || $json.drive_id }}', '\\s.*$', '') ~ '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{25,}$' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM whatsapp_queue WHERE (regexp_replace(producto, '\s+', ' ', 'g') = regexp_replace('{{ ($json.PRODUCTO || $json.producto || '').replace(/'/g, "''").replace(/Limpiar.*$/,'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim() }}', '\s+', ' ', 'g') OR drive_id = regexp_replace('{{ $json.DRIVE_ID || $json.drive_id }}', '\s.*$', '')) AND (estado = 'PENDIENTE' OR (estado = 'FALLIDO' AND fecha_envio > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours')));
